title: Detailed hot air balloon
svg:
<svg viewBox='0 0 100 100' xmlns='http://www.w3.org/2000/svg' width='100' height='100'>
  <defs>
    <radialGradient id='balloonGrad' cx='50%' cy='40%' r='50%'>
      <stop offset='0%' stop-color='#FF6B6B'/>
      <stop offset='50%' stop-color='#FFD93D'/>
      <stop offset='100%' stop-color='#FF8C42'/>
    </radialGradient>
  </defs>

  <!-- Balloon envelope -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='30' ry='32' fill='#E8453C'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='24' ry='30' fill='#FFD93D'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='16' ry='28' fill='#FF8C42'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='38' rx='8' ry='26' fill='#FFEAA7'/>

  <!-- Vertical gores -->
  <path d='M50 6 Q28 20 28 38 Q28 58 42 66' fill='none' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M50 6 Q72 20 72 38 Q72 58 58 66' fill='none' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <path d='M50 6 Q38 20 38 38 Q38 58 47 66' fill='none' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='1'/>
  <path d='M50 6 Q62 20 62 38 Q62 58 53 66' fill='none' stroke='#E67E22' stroke-width='1'/>

  <!-- Horizontal band -->
  <path d='M20 40 Q50 44 80 40' fill='none' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <path d='M22 52 Q50 56 78 52' fill='none' stroke='#C0392B' stroke-width='1.5'/>

  <!-- Highlight -->
  <ellipse cx='42' cy='24' rx='8' ry='12' fill='#FFF5CC' opacity='0.35'/>

  <!-- Balloon bottom opening -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='68' rx='10' ry='3' fill='#B03A2E'/>

  <!-- Ropes -->
  <line x1='42' y1='68' x2='42' y2='78' stroke='#F0C070' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='58' y1='68' x2='58' y2='78' stroke='#F0C070' stroke-width='1.5'/>
  <line x1='46' y1='68' x2='45' y2='78' stroke='#F0C070' stroke-width='1.2'/>
  <line x1='54' y1='68' x2='55' y2='78' stroke='#F0C070' stroke-width='1.2'/>

  <!-- Basket -->
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='24' height='14' rx='2' fill='#C8860A'/>
  <rect x='38' y='78' width='24' height='3' rx='1' fill='#E6A817'/>
  <line x1='44' y1='78' x2='44' y2='92' stroke='#A06A00' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='50' y1='78' x2='50' y2='92' stroke='#A06A00' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='56' y1='78' x2='56' y2='92' stroke='#A06A00' stroke-width='0.8'/>
  <line x1='38' y1='85' x2='62' y2='85' stroke='#A06A00' stroke-width='0.8'/>

  <!-- Small burner flame -->
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='73' rx='3' ry='4' fill='#FFB347'/>
  <ellipse cx='50' cy='72' rx='1.5' ry='2.5' fill='#FFE066'/>
</svg>
